title: Tübingen registry for autologous stem cell transplantation for severe autoimmune diseases
summary: Autologous stem cell transplantation is a very effective but also aggressive therapy option for severe autoimmune diseases. In order to further improve this therapy option for autoimmune diseases in the future, we want to further evaluate the disease course after stem cell transplantation as well as prognostic factors for side effects with this non-interventional registry study. For this purpose, data from clinical routine will be collected for all patients undergoing stem cell transplantation at the UKT due to a severe autoimmune disease.
conditions: Systemic lupus erythematosus with organ or system involvement

interventions.name:
Autologous stem cell transplantation
 - Mobilisation with cyclophosphamide + granulocyte stimulating factor
 - CD34 + selection
 - Conditioning with cyclophosphamide + antithymocyte globuline
Follow-up for survival and response to treatment every 6 months for 3 years

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Autologous stem cell transplantation for Autoimmune disease
Age > 18 years
informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Autologous stem cell transplantation for other diseases
Age < 18 years
